title: Set pieces are Arsenal's quiet edge again
excerpt: Newcastle concede more from corners than any top-half side. Arsenal have scored four from dead balls already.

title: Atalanta's press is the variable that matters
excerpt: If Inter's back three can play through the first line, the space behind Atalanta's wing-backs is enormous. If not, expect a scrappy, stop-start game.

title: Villa's high line vs Anfield's tempo
excerpt: Villa hold one of the league's highest defensive lines. Against Liverpool's runners in behind, that's a structural risk worth tracking.
